description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzService' responsible for managing permissions and data access related to 'buzz' posts and comments within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It interacts with Data Access Objects (DAO) and handles permission checks for updating and deleting posts and comments.

classes.name: BuzzService
classes.description: Service class managing permissions and DAO access for buzz posts and comments

methods.name: getBuzzDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the BuzzDao instance

methods.name: getBuzzLikeDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the BuzzLikeDao instance

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user can update the specified buzz post

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user can delete the specified buzz post

methods.name: canUpdateBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user can update a specific buzz comment

methods.name: canDeleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Checks if the current user can delete a specific buzz comment
